Dual-zone automatic climate control maintains your preferred temperature, while power-adjustable seats with memory settings ensure every drive feels personalized. The power moonroof adds brightness and airiness to the driving experience.

Safety receives appropriate emphasis with Volvo's proven engineering standards. Four-wheel independent suspension delivers a composed ride, while four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power. The rear parking camera assists with visibility during low-speed maneuvers, and the comprehensive airbag array surrounds occupants with protection.

The exterior presents a commanding presence with its 19-inch Momentum wheels fitted with all-season rubber. The Red Metallic finish catches light beautifully while projecting confidence on the road. Heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators and body-color bumpers complete a cohesive, well-maintained appearance.

This S60 T5 Momentum offers the balance of luxury, reliability, and practical features that Volvo owners have come to expect. A visit to our showroom allows you to experience the cabin's refinement and evaluate the vehicle's overall condition in person.
